Your Telegram bot token from @BotFather

templates.name: Claude Agent
templates.description: An autonomous agent that runs on your own machine. Give it a task; it works to completion using a bash tool and file read/write, streaming its full transcript and token cost to the logs. Your task and its output never leave your infrastructure.
templates.author: berth-team

env_vars.description: Your Anthropic API key from console.anthropic.com
What you want the agent to do (a plain-English task)
Claude model id
Safety cap on agent loop iterations

templates.name: PR Review Agent
templates.description: Claude reviews your open pull requests on a schedule. Each run it checks a GitHub repo for PRs it hasn't seen, reads the diff, and posts review comments — a tireless first-pass reviewer running on your own hardware. Schedule with @hourly.
templates.author: berth-team

env_vars.description: Your Anthropic API key from console.anthropic.com
GitHub token with repo access (github.com/settings/tokens)
Repository to review, as owner/name (e.g. berth-app/berth)
Set to true to print reviews instead of posting them

templates.name: Research Agent
templates.description: A standing research briefing, written by Claude. Give it a topic; it uses live web search to gather current information and writes a dated markdown report. Schedule with @daily to track a competitor, technology, or market.
templates.author: berth-team

env_vars.description: Your Anthropic API key from console.anthropic.com
What to research (e.g. developments in NATS messaging)
Cap on web searches per run

templates.name: OpenRouter Agent
templates.description: An autonomous agent that works to any goal — with any model. One OpenRouter key gives you Claude, GPT, Gemini, Llama, and hundreds more; set OPENROUTER_MODEL to pick. Same bash + file tools as the Claude Agent, running on your own machine.
templates.author: berth-team

env_vars.description: Your OpenRouter API key from openrouter.ai/keys
What you want the agent to do (a plain-English task)
Any model id from openrouter.ai/models
Safety cap on agent loop iterations
